summary: Eltek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that board member Gad Dovev resigned for personal reasons, effective August 1, 2026, with no disagreement with the company. Ilana Lurie was elected to replace him as chair of the audit and compensation committees. This is a routine director resignation and appointment, not a forced or abrupt management change. The filing does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. Therefore, this filing is classified as not a special situation under the defined categories.
